verdict.rationale: Terraform's docs describe importing existing infrastructure into state so it can be managed with Terraform, and point to the `import` block for generating the matching configuration, including importing several resources at once. A community user calls declarative import 'quite simple and safe.' Missing for 10: detailed documentation of the config-generation workflow (e.g., how generated code is written and what quality or limits it has), and independent hands-on corroboration of the generated configuration.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can import existing cloud resources under management and generate matching configuration code

citations.quote: This topic provides an overview of the Terraform commands that let you import existing infrastructure resources so that you can manage them with Terraform.
If you want to generate the accompanying configuration for imported resources, use the `import` block instead
You can specify multiple resources in the `import` block to import more than one resource at a time.
Impressed by recent declarative handling of imperative actions such as import and state moves.
